summary.name: c/selfhost on Lemmy
summary.one_liner: A Lemmy community (lemmy.ml) where people share self-hosted alternatives to popular online services, plus questions and project posts about self-hosting.
use_cases: Find self-hosted alternatives to online services
Follow news on Portainer, Jellyfin and Nextcloud
Get help setting up a home server
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Lemmy community feed for self-hosting, where members post alternatives to popular online services that can be run without giving up privacy. Posts are tagged by type, such as [Question], [Help], [Project], [Other] and [Promoting]. The visible threads cover topics like Nextcloud setup, Jellyfin upgrades, Headscale, Forgejo scraping protection, Matrix on a Raspberry Pi, and self-made projects such as Natel and Songhive. The community has a posted rule set covering cross-posting to related communities and moderation. The page itself is a listing of posts, not a tool.
notable: Posts are tagged by type ([Question], [Help], [Project], [Other], [Promoting]) since Lemmy has no native tags
Listed in awesome-selfhosted under external links
Cross-posting allowed with related communities such as c/docker, c/portainer and c/selfhosted
caveats: Posts without a required tag were announced for removal starting 1 January
Content is user-posted and not moderated for accuracy by the page itself
